headline: WeBuyCars CEO Wynand Beukes to Step Down Following 18.5% Earnings Drop
summary: WeBuyCars co-founder Wynand Beukes will step down as CEO in January after the South African pre-owned vehicle trader posted an 18.5% fall in annual headline earnings.
why: WeBuyCars is one of South Africa's largest listed automotive traders, serving as an indicator of domestic consumer spending power.

impacts.name: WeBuyCars
impacts.why: The CEO announced his departure following an 18.5% decline in annual headline earnings.
